verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community report that Proton Pass's browser-extension telemetry can be disabled, but only through the Proton account settings, not in the extension itself. That is a real but coarse opt-out, and the same report says data is always sent to the remote endpoint. missing for 10: first-party documentation of telemetry/usage-tracking controls, an in-client (extension/app/CLI) opt-out, confirmation of what data is collected and that disabling stops transmission, independent hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: the only way to disable it is from your Proton account, not the extension itself.
